name: xdBot Audiotrack
description: Adds an Audiotrack section to the xdBot menu: align a .wav (clicks) to the macro's first input and play it with the macro.

mic-device.name: Microphone
mic-device.description: Part of the real microphone's name to pass through the Audiotrack Mic cable. Empty = the default microphone.

start-mixer.name: Start the mixer with the game
start-mixer.description: Starts the mixer when the game launches (if the Audiotrack driver is installed), so Audiotrack Mic carries your voice as long as GD is open.
